test_title: RRB Group D Official Paper (Held On: 27 Dec, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Based on the English alphabetical order, three of the following four letter-clusters are alike in a certain way and thus form a group. Which letter-cluster DOES NOT belong to that group?

(Note: The odd one out is not based on the number of consonants/vowels or their position in the letter-cluster.)
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/354443682713949bc0557fb0d8a5a2a660a69959dd1d859a74a3dbfa8863ff42.png] 

Logic followed here is: (Letter 1 - 4 = Letter 2) and (Letter 2 - 6 = Letter 3).

1) For IFY:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/aa6ef429ca883214a69d6a9a79cc0093111e5eac1728282b8b77d57999e91091.png] 

**2) For ZVP →**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/43e65ec61190c692b8d2f65cbc4de0d570c4ca5dd9c3fbf50d3e4717f6aeadbd.png] 

**3) For RNH →**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/174acf16171f935fb94a7b1fc68a0450f764ac7ca49a260b428cd04f220a4abd.png] 

**4) For GCW →**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f26156e7f1fc7b3b3bcc82d3171529ad12ea477d002551ac4f70e90416e52cc3.png] 

Therefore, the letter-cluster 'IFY' does not belong to the group as it follows a -3, -7 pattern instead of -4, -6.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 1".**
